Terms: [docs/GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/GLOSSARY.md).

Engine `32ad63782` — OBSERVATIONAL, pre-registered (prereg_event_clock_census, register 104). Two dimensions, mechanisms SEPARATED: scheduled news (+/-15/30 min around macro_releases.csv timestamps, currency-tagged; cross-tagging reported never assumed) and auction slots (native cash open/close +/-15/30; UTC values valid for the August store). CALENDAR COVERAGE: 2026-07-14 → 2026-08-28 (25 High USD/GBP rows); VERIFIED-EMPTY (dated, attributed in data/macro_releases_log.md): [['2026-08-20', '2026-08-22']] counts as no-news; 0 journal rows on uncovered days are EXCLUDED from news cells (never no-news); auction cells cover all days. STATISTIC SHAPES (74-B): in-window vs out-of-window hit-rate gap (reach for the scalp arms, win for the ladder variants) vs a label-permutation null (100 pinned seeds) — per-cell p95 and the field count vs null; stop-rate and net points descriptive; measurable = both sides >= 10; candidate = |gap| >= 10pp beyond its null on >= 3 of 4 forward legs, same sign. Fill models: the journal's PESSIMISTIC rows; the scalp arms' optimistic target fill declared (register 94). Ex-lockbox. Rule candidates on survival are mechanism-matched and separate (news-window pause / open-window pause), distinguished from register 103's failed reactive cooldowns by their EX-ANTE mechanism; front door, ratification required.

**Luck budget:** 162 of 314 measurable cells reach |gap| >= 10pp vs null median 98.0 / p95 115.0; percentile 100.0.
